Title: Rohan's Little Adventure

Cast

1. Rohan - 9 years, son
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts
2. Sonali - 39 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez
3. Nitin - 39 years, father
Look: glasses, brown sweater

Places

1. The bathroom - a tap, a bucket, a mirror
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
3. The road - a paved road, trees along it

Scene 1: The bathroom - Day

[Rohan stands in the bathroom. Sonali stands near him.]

Rohan: "Let's do something fun today."

[Rohan brushes his teeth at the sink.]

Rohan: "This is amazing!"

[Rohan takes a quick bath.]

Rohan (surprised): "I knew it!"

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

[Rohan stands in the courtyard. Sonali and Nitin stand near him.]

Rohan: "Let's begin."

[Rohan runs to Mother.]

Nitin (softly): "Yes, all right."

[Rohan scratches his head.]

Rohan: "Careful!"

[Rohan starts crying.]

Rohan: "Careful!"

[Rohan folds his hands and prays.]

Sonali (laughing): "Careful!"

[Suddenly it begins to pour.]

Nitin: "This is amazing!"

[A cool breeze blows through the courtyard.]

Rohan (softly): "Really?"

[A rainbow appears in the sky.]

Nitin (laughing): "Well done!"

Scene 3: The road - Day

Sonali: "What a nice place."

[Rohan rides his bicycle down the road.]

Rohan: "Dad, listen!"

[Rohan gets on the bus.]

Rohan: "Oh wow!"

[Rohan gets off the school bus.]

Nitin: "That's easy."

[Rohan hops into an auto-rickshaw.]

Sonali (softly): "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
